Christ gave himself for our sins to deliver us. What has Jesus delivered you from?
Paul was astonished they were turning to a different gospel. What is the true gospel, in your own words?
Paul asks, "Am I trying to please man?" Whose approval are you seeking?
People glorified God because of the change in Paul. How has God changed your story?
The leaders saw the grace given to Paul and gave him the right hand of fellowship. How can you recognise God's grace in others?
Paul opposed Peter for not acting in step with the gospel. Where might fear of others lead you away from the gospel?
We are justified by faith in Christ, not works of the law. Why does this matter?
"I have been crucified with Christ. It is no longer I who live, but Christ who lives in me." What does this mean for you?
Paul asks, "Having begun by the Spirit, are you now being perfected by the flesh?" Where are you trying in your own strength?
Christ redeemed us from the curse by becoming a curse for us. What does that mean to you?
The law was our guardian until Christ came. What was the law's purpose?
In Christ there is neither Jew nor Greek, slave nor free, male and female; you are all one. How should this shape your fellowship?
God sent the Spirit of his Son into our hearts, crying "Abba! Father!" What does it mean to call God Father?
Paul asks why they would turn back to weak and worthless things. What old habits pull you back?
Paul was in anguish until Christ was formed in them. How is Christ being formed in you?
Paul says we are children of the free woman, children of promise. What does freedom in Christ mean to you?
"For freedom Christ has set us free; stand firm." What would it look like to stand firm in that freedom?
What counts is faith working through love. How is your faith showing itself in love?
Paul says to use freedom to serve one another in love. How could you serve someone this week?
Which fruit of the Spirit do you most want to grow in, and why?
Bear one another's burdens. Whose burden could you help carry?
"Let us not grow weary of doing good." Where are you growing weary?
Paul will boast only in the cross. What does the cross mean to you?
What counts is a new creation. How are you a new creation in Christ?
